value.notes: First exploratory run. Checking movement, dash recharge (should show Dash 5 after dash, then count down), pause freezing, esc resume. Need to check HUD vs state, and that paused ticks do nothing.

Run 1 showed no clear bug yet. Suspect: enemy e2 (seed 42) move phase may shift across a pause/resume (moved on running clocks 1,3,6,8,10,12,14; a gap of 3 ticks breaks every-other-tick rule). Run 2 is a no-pause baseline with 8 waits to compare e2 timing. If e2 moves every other running tick with no pause, then pause/resume shifts enemy phase (bug: 'nothing moves while paused' / timing). Also still untested: dash cooldown while paused, Enter key in pause, restart, gems/relics, spikes, hits, invulnerability, timer 0, game over, exit, Finish/Play again, score cap.

Run 1 vs run 2 shows e1 and e2 both move on every other running tick, no shift seen with no pause. Run 1 with pause looked consistent (dash-down after a dash was a step, as cooldown>0). Next: check dash cooldown freezes while paused, and that the tick-of-pause input is ignored. Plan run 3: right dash-right pause wait wait wait esc wait. Expect cooldown 5 after dash, frozen at 5 while paused, 4 after first resumed tick.

Runs 1-3 show no bugs. Dash cooldown freezes while paused (5 held through 4 paused ticks), decrements on resume tick, enemies alternate every other running tick: all consistent with the design. Run 4 probes spikes at (3,3) via path right x3, down x2, left. Expect lives 2, score floored at 0 (or 100-500 clamped to 0), spike event. If it is consistent, the next probe is the Enter key on pause dialog and the time-bonus/exit path. Budget is nearly spent, so finish soon.

Found one clear bug: stepping onto spikes with a low score wraps the score around to about 65,136 instead of flooring at 0. Seed 42, run 4: score was 100 before the spike hit, and afterwards the HUD and state both show 65136 (65536 - 400). The design says spikes cost 500 points and the score never goes below 0. The 6-token sequence is the shortest route to the spikes at (3,3) from the start, since the only path goes through (4,1) to collect the coin. Dropping any token changes the route, so this is effectively minimal. I did not re-verify the score-0 case or the exact wrap constant with spare budget, so treat the wrap as observed rather than characterised further. Remaining budget is nearly spent, so I am finishing.

reports.title: Spike hit with low score wraps score to ~65136 instead of flooring at 0
reports.observed: Score was 100 after collecting a coin. Stepping onto spikes at (3,3) cost a life (lives 3->2, respawn at (1,1)) but the score became 65136 (HUD 'Score 65136'), which equals 100 - 500 wrapped modulo 65536.
reports.expected: Spikes subtract 500 points but the score is floored at 0 and never goes negative, so the score should read 0 after the hit.
